name: Ankit
summary:
Aspiring to contribute as a Chartered Accountant in a dynamic environment that fosters learning and professional
growth opportunities, while effectively leveraging my skills to enhance the organization's success

responsibilities: (Leading CA firm with 25+ years of practice)
Conducted all kinds of Bank audits ranging from Statutory, Concurrent, Revenue, Credit audits according to Banking regulations.
Led Concurrent audit of Public Sector branch having exposure in advances of more than ₹ 500 crores
Conducted unit visits and prepared stock audit reports of 20+ parties.
Found revenue leakage totaling ₹1.8 crores in my tenure

Led execution of statutory and tax audits for clients across manufacturing, trading, and service sectors, including preparation and review of financial statements in compliance with Schedule III of the Companies Act, 2013.
Statutory audit of Punjab Land Records Society
Assisted in drafting and reporting of matters pertaining to auditee’s Financial Statement as per SA 700,705, and reporting under CARO 2020.
Checked and verified capitalization, depreciation and disclosure of PPE as per IND AS 16 and AS 10 read with Schedule II of Companies Act, 2013.
Executed inventory audit procedures including physical verification, valuation testing, and cut-off checks to ensure accuracy and completeness of inventory records.
Performed audit procedures to verify revenue recognition as per Ind AS 115, ensuring compliance with accounting standards and identifying potential misstatements.
Prepared and filed Income Tax Returns (ITR) for corporate and non-corporate entities ensuring accuracy and compliance.
Assisted in preparation and review of Tax Audit Reports under Section 44AB of the Income Tax Act, 1961
Prepared and filed GST returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, and GSTR-9) for clients with monthly turnover ranging from ₹5 Cr to ₹150 Cr.
Performed Input Tax Credit reconciliation (GSTR-2B vs Books) to ensure accurate tax reporting.
Handled GST registrations, amendments and assisted in responding to departmental notices.
Assisted in forensic audit assignments involving review of financial transactions, supporting documents, and accounting records
Performed bank statement analysis, transaction tracing, and verification of invoices and contracts to identify anomalies and potential fraud indicators.
Conducted data analysis and reconciliations to investigate unusual transactions and assess compliance with internal policies.
Assisted in drafting investigation reports for Insolvency Professional review.

Achievements: Participated in inter school debate and extempore competitions.
Participated in Cricket tournaments and Olympiads
Served as Social Media Committee Member at ICAI Student National Conference, managing digital engagement and event
Actively participated in organizing school annual functions and cultural events, developing coordination and leadership
